notes: SHIP v1.14.355 - FIX-DESKTOP-NAV-CARDS §3 COMPONENTS card surface unification (Option A, owner ruling 2026-07-25). Opens a NEW batch at 1 of 6 (the .351-.354 batch was device-CLEARED by owner 2026-07-25). THE FINDING THAT SET THE MECHANISM: the plan/notes originally said 'swap the COMPONENTS card inline background:var(--surf-1) to --rd-cardfill' - that swap is DEAD under redesign. The card carries class=gsk, and body.rd .gsk{background:<glass-skin gradient> !important} (the only sanctioned !important in the glass system, ~L11852) overrides the inline; !important stylesheet beats inline. So under redesign the card renders the LIGHTER blue glass-skin (#0b1019..#0a0f1a + a rgba(140,172,206,.10) sheen), not --surf-1 - and that lighter surface IS the 'still tinted' symptom §3 reports. The inline only paints under ?legacy=1 (where .gsk is class-inert). --rd-cardfill (the near-black 98 RACKS stat-tile fill, linear-gradient(158deg,#050506..#000000..#030304)) is NOT a .gsk consumer, so the COMPONENTS card was the last tinted card on the rack-detail surface. THE FIX (Option A - card-scoped, blast radius = 1 card, fill only): (1) CSS - added body.rd .gsk.gsk-flat{background:var(--rd-cardfill) !important} right after the base .gsk rule. Specificity (0,3,1) beats body.rd .gsk (0,2,1); both !important, so this wins and repoints ONLY this card's fill to the stat-tile black. Only background is overridden - .gsk border/radius/box-shadow cascade unchanged (fill only, per §3). Net CSS braces +1 pair (balanced). (2) JS - in deploy_showRackDetail the COMPONENTS card div now emits class='gsk gsk-flat' when (typeof redesign_isOn==='function' && redesign_isOn()), else plain class='gsk'. The marker is REDESIGN-GATED, so ?legacy=1 emits exactly the original bytes (class=gsk + inline background:var(--surf-1)) and stays byte-identical - this is the shared-function discipline the .354 Rule-11 near-miss taught (deploy_showRackDetail renders under BOTH #wk-deploy redesign and #ops-content legacy from one innerHTML write). Precedent for the technique: the .343 body.rd #pg-cmd .sigrow override that repointed a glass card to --rd-cardfill and kept its hairline. RACK SCENE LOCK: untouched - no lights/exposure/fog/tone-mapping/type-colour/geometry value changed; this is card CSS + one gated class token. web-Claude specs untouched. Gates: inline-JS vm.Script x3, sw.js compile, valid JSON, CSS brace net-0 delta beyond the +1 balanced pair, three-stamp .354->.355, CRLF preserved (Edit, no sed). DEVICE-VERIFY (clear SW first), REDESIGN rack detail: the COMPONENTS card (COMPONENTS / N DEVICES header + the per-category GPU/SWITCH/etc bars) now reads the SAME near-black as the 98 RACKS stat tile / assistant card - no lighter blue/grey cast; its border/corners/shadow unchanged. NOTE FOR THE EYE: this card's on-page neighbours (the rack-detail phase/state cards) are ALSO .gsk and stay on the lighter glass look - so COMPONENTS now matches Home's stat tiles but is intentionally darker than its sibling phase cards on this page (Option A was chosen over closing it; if that local contrast reads wrong, the ship reverts in one commit). ?legacy=1 rack detail: COMPONENTS card UNCHANGED (plain .gsk + inline --surf-1, the lighter glass skin) - pixel-identical to .354. ROLLBACK: revert this commit.
